description_en: Retrieves the lifecycle of an instance
name: GetLifecycle

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The sequence number offset of the instance session. A session represents the process of an instance from startup to failure or termination
parameters.help_zh: 一个Session为实例从启动到失败或停止的过程，sessionNumber表示实例Session的序号偏移值
parameters.name: session_number

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of sessions to retrieve
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the results. Valid values:
ASC: ascending order by time
DESC: descending order by time
parameters.help_zh:
结果的排序方式，取值如下：
ASC：按时间升序。
DESC：按时间降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The token used to share the URL
parameters.name: token

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:
InternalError: An internal error occurred. All errors other than parameter validation errors are classified as internal errors.
ValidationError: A parameter validation error occurred
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：
InternalError：内部错误（除了参数验证错误外的其他错误，目前都归类到内部错误）。
ValidationError：参数验证错误

Lifecycle.description_en: The retrieved instance life epoch details
Lifecycle.description_zh: 获取到的实例生命周期详情

items.description_en: The list of lifecycle results. Each item represents the lifecycle of a session
items.description_zh: 生命周期结果列表，每一个子项为一个Session对应的生命周期

items.description_en: The lifecycle details of a session
items.description_zh: 其中一个Session对应的生命周期详情

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the status was created, which indicates when the instance transitioned to this status (GMT)
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 该状态创建的时间，即流转到该状态的时间（GMT）

GmtEndTime.description_en: The end time of the lifecycle record
GmtEndTime.description_zh: 生命周期记录的结束时间

LifecycleId.description_en: The ID of the lifecycle record

ReasonCode.description_en: The reason code for the event
ReasonCode.description_zh: 发生某种事件的原因对应的代码

ReasonMessage.description_en: The description of the reason for the event
ReasonMessage.description_zh: 发生某种事件的原因描述

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:
Creating: The instance is being created.
SaveFailed: The instance image failed to save.
Stopped: The instance is stopped.
Failed: The instance failed to be created.
ResourceAllocating: Resources are being allocated.
Stopping: The instance is being stopped.
Updating: The instance is being updated.
Saving: The instance is being saved.
Starting: The instance is being started.
Running: The instance is running.
Saved: The instance is saved.
EnvPreparing: The environment is being prepared.
ArrearStopping: The instance is being stopped due to an overdue payment.
Arrearge: The instance is stopped due to an overdue payment.
Queuing: The instance is in the queue.
Recovering: The instance is being recovered
Status.description_zh:
实例所处的状态。可能值：
Creating：创建中。
SaveFailed：实例镜像保存失败。
Stopped：已停止。
Failed：实例创建失败。
ResourceAllocating：资源准备中。
Stopping：停止中。
Updating：更新中。
Saving：保存中。
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Saved：已保存。
EnvPreparing：环境准备中。
ArrearStopping：欠费停机中。
Arrearge：欠费停机。
Queuing：排队中。
Recovering：恢复中

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true
false
Success.description_zh:
成功标志，可能值：
true
false

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of sessions returned by the query
